description: Check whether one IP address belongs to a known VPN, proxy (including residential and open proxies), Tor exit, relay, hosting or CDN network. Returns classification (for example vpn, proxy, tor, hosting, cdn or unknown), provider, confidence, risk_score (0-100), is_vpn / is_proxy / is_tor and related flags, first and last seen times, ASN and netblock owner, reason codes, and plan-dependent fields that read null or false below the plan that unlocks them. Detection data is IPv4-first: IPv6 addresses are accepted but most return unknown. Reserved and private addresses are rejected. Costs 1 VPN & Proxy Detection API credit per successful lookup. Use this to vet the IP behind a login, signup or API call. Do NOT use this for location data (use `ipgeolocation`) or for 2 or more IPs (use `bulk_vpn_proxy_detection`).

ip_address.description: IP address to classify (e.g., 185.220.101.1). IPv4 recommended; see the tool description for IPv6.

name: vpn_proxy_detection
